(DrawImage): Fix oss-fuzz issue 14173 diff --git a/coders/pdb.c b/coders/pdb.c index 81676e32b77fb0cf4e6b518d1e6e3322f1868294_Y29kZXJzL3BkYi5j..ce367bc7f85e0b1fd312c8cbd024cb502b12985b_Y29kZXJzL3BkYi5j 100644 --- a/coders/pdb.c +++ b/coders/pdb.c @@ -965,6 +965,7 @@ { if (!AcquireImagePixels(image,0,y,image->columns,1,&image->exception)) break; + (void) memset(scanline,0,image->columns*packet_size); /* FIXME: remove */ (void) ExportImagePixelArea(image,GrayQuantum,bits_per_pixel,scanline,0,0); for (x=0; x < pdb_image.width; x++) { diff --git a/www/Changelog.html b/www/Changelog.html index 81676e32b77fb0cf4e6b518d1e6e3322f1868294_d3d3L0NoYW5nZWxvZy5odG1s..ce367bc7f85e0b1fd312c8cbd024cb502b12985b_d3d3L0NoYW5nZWxvZy5odG1s 100644 --- a/www/Changelog.html +++ b/www/Changelog.html @@ -38,8 +38,14 @@

2019-04-13 Bob Friesenhahn <bfriesen@simple.dallas.tx.us>

    +
  • coders/pdb.c (WritePDBImage): Assure that input scanline is +cleared in order to cover up some decoder bug. May fix 14215 +"graphicsmagick/coder_PDB_fuzzer: Use-of-uninitialized-value in +WritePDBImage", which I have not been able to reproduce.
  • magick/render.c (DrawPrimitive): Check primitive point x/y -values for NaN.
    • +values for NaN. +(DrawImage): Fix oss-fuzz issue 14173 +"graphicsmagick/coder_MVG_fuzzer: Integer-overflow in DrawImage".
  • magick/pixel_cache.c (SetNexus): Fix oss-fuzz issue 14208 "graphicsmagick/coder_MVG_fuzzer: Integer-overflow in SetNexus".
